limits: vehicleDoors().sourceGeometryRestored compares every source geometry attribute after repair. Per-layer attribute names are covered by the separate host rig test; this public runtime report does not expose their arrays.

Aircraft source identity, shared kit, exact-id extents, projected visibility and aggregate vehicle draw geometry are checked. Public APIs do not expose individual live hinge transforms; screenshots retain the actual controlled model and flight HUD.

The four airframes use three engine families: piston, turboprop and turbofan; business jet and airliner intentionally share the turbofan family. Correct profile selection and distinct output gain are observable; isolated spectral proofs are in the audio audit.
Software WebGL checks shader/runtime behavior, not hardware FPS or subjective appearance/sound approval.
